articles.title: MarJon Beauchamp Signs With Bayern Munich
articles.description: Veteran NBA guard MarJon Beauchamp is headed overseas for the upcoming season. Beauchamp signed with Bayern Munich of the German BBL and EuroLeague. Beauchamp spent most of last season on a two-way contract with the Philadelphia 76ers. The 6-foot-7 guard appeared in 14 NBA games for the Sixers. In 24 G League games with the Delaware Blue Coats, Beauchamp averaged 23.8 points, 5.4 rebounds, 4.0 assists and 1.5 blocks per game. The four-year NBA veteran started his career with the Milwaukee Bucks after being a first-round pick in the 2022 NBA Draft. Beauchamp has also played for the New York Knicks and LA Clippers during his NBA career.
